comment: M5-037: the single-seat ground vehicle source table. One row describes one hull: max_health/defense reuse the shared HealthComponent pool and damage-formula units, max_speed_cm_s is the ground top speed in cm/s and acceleration_cm_s2 the throttle acceleration in cm/s^2 on the X/Y floor plane (X lateral, Y depth, Z height), mesh_path is a /Game soft reference to the hull mesh, and the camera block drives the vehicle follow camera (distance/height in cm, pitch in degrees). Only drive_type 'ground' exists: aircraft and boat drive types are refused by the parser and the validator, never silently ignored. New vehicles join by adding a row here and a manifest registration, never by script branches.
